narrative: The technology sector is buzzing with advancements in AI, infrastructure, and space. OpenAI is pioneering data center power plants for grid stability, while new AI agents from Momentic and 42AI promise to revolutionize software quality assurance and human behavior prediction. Meanwhile, major tech acquisitions and legal battles over AI scraping underscore the dynamic and evolving landscape of digital innovation and its societal impact.

highlights.title: OpenAI pitches data center power plants as a way to protect nearby areas
highlights.whyItMatters: This initiative addresses grid reliability and consumer electricity costs by integrating data center power with local utilities during emergencies.

highlights.title: In one of the largest deals in tech history, Marvell buys Lumentum for $115B
highlights.whyItMatters: This significant acquisition reshapes the tech landscape, especially with Nvidia's strategic investment, indicating major shifts in hardware and AI integration.

highlights.title: The New York Times sues Brave web browser for AI scraping and bypassing paywalls
highlights.whyItMatters: This lawsuit highlights growing legal challenges and ethical concerns surrounding AI training data acquisition and content monetization for publishers.

highlights.title: Readwise takes on Amazon’s Kindle and Goodreads with its new app for book lovers
highlights.whyItMatters: Readwise's new app, integrating AI features, aims to disrupt the established e-reading and social reading market dominated by Amazon.

highlights.title: NASA Invites Media to Northrop Grumman CRS-25 Station Resupply Launch
highlights.whyItMatters: This upcoming launch underscores ongoing efforts to support the International Space Station with crucial supplies and scientific investigations.

highlights.title: Momentic (YC W24) – Agents that catch bugs by using your app
highlights.whyItMatters: Momentic introduces innovative QA agents that autonomously test applications, promising to enhance software quality and efficiency in development.

highlights.title: AWS Weekly Roundup: GPT-6.1 Terra on Bedrock, Step Functions as agent tools
highlights.whyItMatters: AWS continues to expand its AI capabilities, integrating advanced models like GPT-6.1 Terra and enabling Step Functions as powerful tools for AI agents.

highlights.title: 42AI comes out of stealth with $62.5M and a world model that can ‘predict human behavior’
highlights.whyItMatters: This significant funding and the development of a predictive AI model from 42AI signal a major advancement in understanding and anticipating human actions.

topics.name: AI & Agents
topics.summary: The rapid development and deployment of AI agents across various domains, including software testing, behavioral prediction, and enterprise workflows.

topics.name: Technology & Infrastructure
topics.summary: Significant shifts in tech acquisitions, data center power management, and cloud services, addressing both innovation and critical operational challenges.

topics.name: Space & Science
topics.summary: Ongoing missions and discoveries in space, including resupply launches to the ISS and new astronomical observations.
